_comment: Watched keywords for the daily Europe PMC digest. Edit this file to change what gets fetched. Each keyword runs as: (TITLE:"kw" OR ABSTRACT:"kw") AND CREATION_DATE:[date TO date]
_always_include_journals: Papers from these journals are ALWAYS included even if no keyword matches. Europe PMC indexes only biomedical content, so all hits from generalist titles like Nature/Science are already bio. Add Nature Genetics, Cell Reports, etc. to expand. Match is exact on the JOURNAL field.
_query_tips: If a keyword is too noisy, change its entry to a raw EPMC query string in 'keyword_overrides' below. The override replaces the (TITLE OR ABSTRACT) wrapper but the CREATION_DATE filter is still appended.
